definitions.gloss: must arrive by; required arrival by a deadline
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a document, application, or item must physically arrive at the destination by a specified date. Contrasts with {消印有効|けしいんゆうこう}, where the postmark date counts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十月|じゅうがつ}→十月：00634_juugatsu⟧{三十一日|さんじゅういちにち}{必着|ひっちゃく}です。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧{必着|ひっちゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please send the documents so they arrive by Friday.

examples.japanese: {必着|ひっちゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧よう、⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent it by express mail to make the must-arrive deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {必|ひっ} (must, certainly) and ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arrival). Very common in application deadlines for jobs, contests, government forms, and university admissions. Always used with a date to specify when the item must arrive.

IMPORTANT CONTRAST:
- {必着|ひっちゃく}: the item must physically arrive by the date
- {消印有効|けしいんゆうこう}: valid if postmarked by the date — more lenient, as only the mailing date matters

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧{必着|ひっちゃく} (must arrive by ~ date)
- {必着|ひっちゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send for required arrival)
- {必着|ひっちゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧ (a must-arrive deadline)
